approved_scope_change: User explicitly approved symptom and cause/effect fidelity instead of electron-level simulation on 2026-10-15. V2 supersedes scientific V1 as the game completion standard.
policy: Keep EC-01 through EC-09 fixed. Close only against the criteria below with checked-in regression evidence and passing game CI. New fidelity work needs a separate explicit scope decision. A closed package is reopened only by a regression against these criteria.
fidelity: Source-informed controls, plausible service readings, coherent symptoms and repeatable repair outcomes from one deterministic model. Readings are game approximations, not historical calibration.
optional_research: Exact undocumented socket wiring, lead dress and winding parameters
